chunks: 4911 - Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said in his will to his son Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥanafiyyah:

O my son, when you are strong, then be strong in obedience to Allah, and when you are weak, then be weak from disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. And if you are able not to give a woman control over any of her affair beyond herself, then do so, for that is more lasting for her beauty, more relaxing for her mind, and better for her condition. Indeed, the woman is a delicate flower and not a caretaker. So treat her gently in every circumstance, and keep good companionship with her, so that your life may be pleasant.

key_terms.الصُّحْبَةَ: companionship; good and gracious conduct in living together
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman, in the context of marital and household relations
key_terms.بِقَهْرَمَانَةٍ: not a manager or steward charged with burdensome administration
key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: a delicate flower; an expression of softness and delicacy
key_terms.طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ: obedience to Allah through faithful submission and righteous action
key_terms.عَيْشُكَ: your living; your life and domestic well-being
key_terms.فَدَارِهَا: deal gently and tactfully with her
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ: disobedience to Allah through sinful conduct

ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام advise about obedience to Allah and treatment of one's wife?
ai.summary: This saying of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام teaches moral discipline by directing strength toward obedience and withholding weakness from sin. It also advises kind and considerate conduct within family life, emphasizing gentleness, good companionship, and maintaining harmony in one's household.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4911 - Commander of the Faithful (as) said in his will to his son Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah:

"O my son, when you are strong, be strong in obedience to Allah (swt), and when you are weak, be weak in disobedience to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.
And if you can avoid giving a woman authority over anything beyond herself, then do so, for it preserves her beauty longer, brings more comfort to her mind, and improves her condition. Indeed, a woman is like a delicate flower, not a caretaker. So, be gentle with her in every situation and maintain good companionship with her so that your life may be peaceful."
